name: marimba
doc: A marimba, measured from the University of Iowa's marimba struck with yarn mallets.

options.name: vel
options.doc: How hard the bar is struck.

options.name: attack
options.doc: How long the note takes to rise to attack_level.

options.name: decay
options.doc: How long it then takes to fall to decay_level.

options.name: release
options.doc: How long it then takes to fall silent.

options.name: attack_level
options.doc: The level the attack rises to.

options.name: decay_level
options.doc: The level the decay falls to; sustain_level when below 0.

options.name: sustain_level
options.doc: The level the note holds at.
